properties.description: tools/test_wall_check.py, 11 cases, run in CI on every push. The wall check reads a project's SOURCE from outside reflow2 and compares the coupling it finds against the boundaries the design declares, with no configuration — the design already says where its code lives. Distinct from the structural detectors, which reason about the graph: this one reads the tree and can therefore contradict it.
properties.findings: Run 2026-08-23 on this checkout: 11 cases, all passing (0.739s). Also runs in CI on every push (.github/workflows/ci.yml).
properties.name: A declared wall is checked against the coupling it actually contains
